SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL
BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF REGENERATION. MINIMUM CENTRAL
PRESSURE AT 220600Z IS 975 MB. MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT
220600Z IS 31 FEET.//
